title: Kajian Kemasan Tape Ketan sebagai Identitas Khas Kuningan Jawa Barat

original_source.central_claim: Harum Sari black-bucket tape-ketan packaging persists as a distinctive Kuningan identity despite asserted plastic-safety concerns

central_claims: The black bucket is a distinctive identity marker of Harum Sari/Kuningan tape ketan and is retained for that reason.
The paper asserts that plastic in this packaging presents health concerns.

source_manifest.title: Kajian Kemasan Tape Ketan sebagai Identitas Khas Kuningan Jawa Barat: Studi Kasus Merek Harum Sari
source_manifest.finding: A critical design case study links black-bucket packaging to Kuningan identity and raises material-safety concerns; only abstract and introductory text were accessible.

source_manifest.title: Perancangan Kemasan Tape Ketan Sari Asih Kabupaten Kuningan
source_manifest.finding: An independent design project on another brand proposes more attractive practical packaging; its abstract reports expected rather than measured sales benefits.

source_manifest.title: FTIR analysis of pyrolyzed LLDPE and polystyrene microparticles and their chemical reaction mechanism completed with computational bibliometric literature review to support sustainable development goals (SDGs)
source_manifest.finding: The target is cited in introductory discussion of plastic shredding. The experiments concern pyrolysis, not Harum Sari packaging identity or food safety.

answers.rationale: Neither the different-brand design abstract nor the pyrolysis paper independently verifies the combined identity and safety claims for Harum Sari.
No independent repeat of the Harum Sari case analysis or direct food-contact material testing was located.
No broader consumer study or stricter toxicological test of the target packaging was verified.
No later authoritative assessment of the Harum Sari identity and material-safety claims was located.
The original full limitations section was inaccessible; no follow-up resolving the case-study and material-testing limitations was identified.
The Sari Asih redesign concerns another brand; a substantive extension explicitly building on the target was not established.
Two related publications do not establish two teams building on this specific contribution: one concerns another brand, the other pyrolysis.
The 2025 reference accompanies a generic statement about plastic shredding, not reuse of the target design analysis.
No review credits the Harum Sari case study with opening a research direction.
No later study uses the Harum Sari analysis as a measured baseline or comparison construction.
The Sari Asih project expresses expected sales benefits; no independently measured benefit from applying the target was found.
Packaging another brand does not establish that the target framework was transferred; no explicit successful application was verified.
The pyrolysis results are experimentally separate from the identity study; their citation does not show that this contribution enabled them.
Continued black-bucket sales would describe a pre-existing practice, not adoption of the paper; no attributable workflow change was documented.
No later comparison of a specific claimed design advantage was found; the incomplete original prevents safely classifying this question as inapplicable.
The 2025 citation is background to plastic processing; it does not establish substantive late use of the identity contribution.
No independent positive evaluation of the central identity and safety claims after July 2021 was verified.
The located 2019 and 2025 works do not establish substantive target-specific independent follow-up in two years.
The 2025 bibliometric component concerns plastic pyrolysis; it does not synthesize the packaging identity claim as valid or useful.
No later evaluation compares the target conclusions with newer packaging materials or consumer-identity evidence.

search_gaps: Abstract/introduction-only assessment: original publisher PDF was indexed but actual repeat opens and download returned 404; alternative publisher path failed, and the mirror explicitly truncates the original.
No direct food-contact safety assay or independent identity study of Harum Sari was read. The paper’s health claim is recorded as its claim, not adopted as a demonstrated fact.
Assigned Computer Science metadata is retained although the paper is a visual-design case study.
Lifetime observation through 2026-09-16; the assigned pilot sample is not an unbiased estimate of all research outcomes.
research.summary: Outcome evidence is insufficient. A related redesign and a later plastic-processing citation do not validate or substantively apply this particular case study. All twenty outcomes remain unknown.
